visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The sequence begins with a close-up of a pair of hands using a sharp chef's knife to slice thin pieces of pink and white pork belly into shorter lengths on a black cutting board. In the background, a white ceramic-coated pan sits on an induction cooktop in a brightly lit, modern kitchen with white countertops and minimalist decor. (2) The scene shifts to a white oval plate where the sliced meat is laid out, and hands are seen grinding black pepper and sprinkling salt over the pork. The lighting is soft and natural, emphasizing the texture of the raw ingredients. Following this, the hands chop green scallions, red chilies, and garlic cloves with rapid, precise movements on a light-colored wooden cutting board. (3) Hands are seen tearing large green cabbage leaves into smaller bite-sized pieces and placing them into a white tray. Next, the creator chops leafy green bok choy and handles a heap of white bean sprouts in a metal strainer. The environment remains consistent, showcasing a clean, organized studio kitchen setting with various bowls and preparation trays. (4) Oil is sprayed into the white pan, and the pork slices are added, sizzling as they are moved with wooden chopsticks. The camera captures the transition as the meat browns, is removed, and then aromatics like chili and garlic are sautéed in the remaining oil. Cabbage is added, followed by the bean sprouts, with a glass lid being placed over the pan to steam the vegetables. (5) The cooked pork is returned to the pan along with a dark brown savory sauce poured from a small yellow bowl. Yellow oil noodles are added to the mix, and the creator uses a spatula to toss the ingredients together until the noodles are thoroughly coated in the sauce. Finally, the scallion greens and bok choy are tossed in for a quick wilt. (6) The finished stir-fry is shown steaming in the pan, garnished with fresh red chili slices. The scene then transitions to the main character, a woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a white shirt and a beige apron, sitting at a wooden table. She uses chopsticks to eat a large portion of the noodles, smiling and nodding with satisfaction while looking directly at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 準備200克左右的豬五花肉片. (2) [Subtitle]: 切成三等份長度. (3) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味. (4) [Subtitle]: 青蔥斜切成段. (5) [Subtitle]: 蔥白、蔥綠分開放. (6) [Subtitle]: 辣椒一條. (7) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭兩瓣 剁成蒜末... (8) [Subtitle]: 高麗菜葉先去掉梗. (9) [Subtitle]: 用手撕成小塊狀. (10) [Subtitle]: 我喜歡多一點蔬菜 再切一點有機青江菜. (11) [Subtitle]: 把豆芽菜清洗乾淨. (12) [Subtitle]: 可以去掉頭尾 看起來會比較清爽些. (13) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡放入少量油. (14) [Subtitle]: 等油熱了，放入五花肉片. (15) [Subtitle]: 煎出表面的焦香. (16) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下～ 等煎出焦香後，先取出來. (17) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡再補一些油. (18) [Subtitle]: 放入辣椒、蒜末、蔥白. (19) [Subtitle]: 煸炒出香氣. (20) [Subtitle]: 放入高麗菜葉. (21) [Subtitle]: 輕輕的翻炒一下. (22) [Subtitle]: 可以蓋一下鍋蓋來炒. (23) [Subtitle]: 搖晃翻炒一下 這樣比較不會噴的都是.. (24) [Subtitle]: 好囉～開蓋～. (25) [Subtitle]: 高麗菜已經軟化 翻炒一下！. (26) [Subtitle]: 繼續放入豆芽菜. (27) [Subtitle]: 同樣可以蓋鍋蓋 翻炒均勻～EASY!. (28) [Subtitle]: 開蓋～❤️. (29) [Subtitle]: 輕輕翻炒就可以了. (30) [Subtitle]: 放回剛剛的五花肉. (31) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻～. (32) [Subtitle]: 嗆入炒麵醬汁： 醬油 5ml 蠔油 10ml 中濃醬汁 15ml 清酒 20ml. (33) [Subtitle]: 快速的拌炒均勻. (34) [Subtitle]: 放入冷藏的油麵. (35) [Subtitle]: 快速翻拌均勻. (36) [Subtitle]: 讓麵也吸收到醬汁～. (37) [Subtitle]: 最後放入青蔥跟青江菜. (38) [Subtitle]: 剩下的 生蒜末 增加蒜香❤️. (39) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜很快熟～ 翻拌一下就可以了！. (40) [Variety]: 像這樣～超級簡單 又好吃到爆的 高麗菜豬肉炒麵 就完成啦～～❤️❤️. (41) [Subtitle]: 起鍋前， 撒上一些胡椒提味❤️. (42) [Subtitle]: 好囉～ 可以開動了！❤️. (43) [Variety]: 超愛吃炒麵❤️❤️ 每次都可以吃掉一大盤～ 哈哈. (44) [Subtitle]: 炒麵的配料沒有一定 大家冰箱有什麼蔬菜 都可以拿來炒麵 一樣好吃！❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 喜歡吃炒麵的朋友 趕快動手試試看！❤️❤️. The background music remains steady, maintaining a cheerful, light-hearted atmosphere through the rhythmic strumming of strings. (3) A distinct crinkling and tearing sound of fresh vegetables is heard, alternating with more percussive chopping. The Foley sound of washing vegetables adds a subtle splashing texture to the mix, while the guitar continues its loop without interruption. (4) A loud, broadband sizzling sound enters as meat hits hot oil, creating a consistent white-noise texture that masks some of the music's finer details. A female voice begins narrating in a friendly, enthusiastic tone, perfectly synchronized with the culinary actions displayed on screen. The narration continues as the sound of liquid sauce splashing into the pan is heard, followed by more sizzling as the ingredients are combined. This is followed by a light, authentic female laugh and a direct address to the audience in a warm, conversational tone.
